name: Self Image 2
overview: Scripture reveals that human beings are uniquely created in the image and likeness of God, as seen in Genesis 1:26-27, establishing our inherent dignity and purpose. This divine design calls us to recognize that our worth is not based on worldly wisdom, strength, or riches, but on our identity as God's creation. Psalms 139:14 affirms that we are fearfully and wonderfully made, highlighting God's intentional craftsmanship. Romans 12:3 encourages a humble and sober self-assessment, grounded in the grace and measure of faith given by God, reminding us to avoid pride and to value ourselves rightly according to His design.
